Ooh, these old shoulders of
mine have been aching like
nobody's business lately...

rows.label: qst502006_msg0002

They've been like this ever
since Prince Zeke returned...

rows.label: qst502006_msg0003

The days my granddaughter massages
my shoulders are the only thing I
look forward to...
